INSTRUCTIONS_A: In this task, words will appear in the center of the screen, one at a time. Each word is the name of a color (rosa, azul, verde or preto) and may be written in any of these colors. You must indicate the word that is written. There is a practice before you start. You will respond with the keys D, F, J and K. Keep the index and middle fingers of both hands on these keys. Each key corresponds to a color: This mapping will always be shown at the bottom of the screen. Press any key to continue.
INSTRUCTIONS_B: In this task, words will appear in the center of the screen, written in different colors. Your task is to indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. Sometimes the word and the color match (for example, the word "verde" written in green), other times they do not match (for example, the word "verde" written in blue); and other times only "XXXXX" appears. Always respond to the color of the word/characters, not to the word. You will respond with the keys D, F, J and K. Keep the index and middle fingers of both hands on these keys. Each key corresponds to a color: This mapping will always be shown at the bottom of the screen. Press any key to continue.
READINGINTRO: READING BLOCK Indicate the word that is written, ignoring the color it is written in. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for verde. Press any key to continue.
NAMINGINTRO: NAMING BLOCK Now the rule changes. In this block, indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for azul. Press any key to continue.
PRACTICE_A_READING: PRACTICE: READING In this task, color names will appear. Read each word and indicate the word that is written, ignoring the color it is written in. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for verde. Press any key to continue.
PRACTICE_A_NAMING: PRACTICE: NAMING Now the rule changes: indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for azul. Press any key to continue.
KEYPRACTICE: Before the practice, learn which color goes with each key. Press D, F, J and K to see the color of each one, as often as you like. When you are ready, press the space bar to start the practice. In the practice, after each response you will be told whether it was correct.
KEYREMINDER: You can review the color of each key by pressing D, F, J and K. When you are ready, press the space bar to start.
FOOTER2_LEITURA: Respond to the written word as quickly and accurately as possible.
FOOTER2_NOMEACAO: Respond to the ink color as quickly and accurately as possible.
